help.title: How to play
help.desktop: ← → / A D — run left-right · Space — adrenaline · F — formation · Esc — pause
help.mobile: Drag your finger to move · Swipe up — adrenaline
help.mechanic.1: Gates change the crowd: ×2, +10, ÷2… Choose your arch wisely!
help.mechanic.2: Conditional gates: green arch — if the crowd is big, red — if small.
help.mechanic.3: Obstacles kill people. Tanks absorb hits, speedsters speed up, magnets attract coins.
help.mechanic.4: Combo grows with every gate without losses and multiplies score.
help.mechanic.5: Adrenaline: fill the bar and press Space — speed, invulnerability and ×2 score.
help.mechanic.6: Bosses: reach the wall and push it with the whole crowd, dodging attacks.
fail.reason.empty: Too few of you remain to continue.
dialog.intro.name: The Leader
dialog.intro.0: The city sleeps. Grey walls, grey faces. But today everything will change.
dialog.intro.1: I am the Leader. Thousands will follow me. We will break through to the Bright Gate.
dialog.intro.2: Gates multiply the crowd — choose your arch wisely. Obstacles cut us down — dodge them.
dialog.w0.name: The Leader
dialog.w0.0: The Grey City is behind us. Ahead — the misty harbor and the first guardian.
dialog.boss0.name: The Guardian
dialog.boss0.0: No further. This wall has stood for a hundred years.
dialog.boss0.1: Leader: Walls fall. Especially when a crowd pushes them.
dialog.w1.name: The Leader
dialog.w1.0: The harbor smells of salt and freedom. They say the wastes beyond have golden skies.
dialog.boss1.name: Ice Rampart
dialog.boss1.0: Cold has frozen the road. Every blow against the ice echoes in your bones.
dialog.boss1.1: Leader: There are many of us. A shared goal keeps us warm.
dialog.w2.name: The Leader
dialog.w2.0: The wastes. Hot and dry, but we will not stop.
dialog.boss2.name: Steel Bulkhead
dialog.boss2.0: Steel knows no mercy. Saws spin, sparks fly.
dialog.boss2.1: Leader: The crowd is stronger than steel — we cannot be broken.
dialog.w3.name: The Leader
dialog.w3.0: The laboratory. Here people experimented on hope.
dialog.boss3.name: Plasma Shield
dialog.boss3.0: Energy strikes from the wall. It learned from lightning.
dialog.boss3.1: Leader: And we learned from freedom. There is a difference.
dialog.w4.name: The Leader
dialog.w4.0: Neon Polis. The Gate is within reach.
dialog.boss4.name: Heavenly Bastion
dialog.boss4.0: The last wall. Beyond it — dawn.
dialog.boss4.1: Leader: The whole crowd, the whole city — in one final push!
dialog.ending.name: The Leader
dialog.ending.0: The wall has fallen. The Bright Gate is open.
dialog.ending.1: The city is no longer grey. Thousands of voices sing at dawn.
dialog.ending.2: This was not my victory. It was the victory of everyone who followed me.
dialog.ending.3: Thank you for being with us. See you on the roads.
credits.title: The End
